section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Location of Switches and Relays
title: PASSENGER COMPARTMENT SWITCHES AND RELAYS

content.description: Upper diagram showing location of switches and relays in the passenger compartment dashboard and door area. Shows the installation positions of various electrical components including seat belt warning relay, defogger relay, turn signal flasher, door lock relay, power window relay, and interior light control relay.

Lower diagram showing location of switches and relays in the lower passenger compartment area. Shows the installation positions of rear wiper control relay, front wiper control relay, fog light relay, and heater relay.
